title: Proximal tibia insertion site
view: Right knee and upper shin from the front, patient supine, leg extended: knee at the top, lateral on the image left, medial on the right.
teachingPoint: Find the tibial tuberosity, then go 1-2 cm distal and medial onto the flat anteromedial surface: a 1 cm target, not the tuberosity and not the crest.
claims: Right leg from the front, lateral on the image left (house laterality).
Purple ring: the tibial tuberosity (record, subtitle).
Teal: a 1 cm target zone 1.5 cm distal and 1.4 cm medial to the tuberosity, on the flat anteromedial surface (record: 1-2 cm distal and medial).
Bracket: 0 to 2 cm distal to the tuberosity, tick at 1 cm.
Labels: Tibial tuberosity, Insertion site, Patella, and the bracket's 1 cm and 2 cm marks (owner, 2026-10-01).
